# Generated by tools/Build-BarradCollegiumProjects.cjs. Edit the generator.
# Native missions own their timers. No delayed country events or GUI activate_decision calls.
# remove_mission invalidates the old timer without executing completion/timeout effects
# (installed documentation/effects_documentation.md). Cancellation is not completion.
# Reset flag dates on every paid attempt; early/replayed old timeouts cannot finish a restart.
# Interactive checkpoints have no mission; trials_running retains the faculty locks.
# The paid experiment reserves workshops through the checkpoint and verification.

 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_revised_contract
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_finish_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_running days < 28 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_running days < 14 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_cancel_theory = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_viira_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -50
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -35 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_done

   HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_timer_valid = yes

    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

 }

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_civilian

   add_political_power = -55
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -40 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_running days < 56 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_running days < 42 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

  HSM_BAR_mtk_sleep_lecture_cancel_trials = yes
 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_cancel_theory = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_revised_contract
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_finish_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_theory_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_cancel_theory = yes
 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_viira_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -60
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -45 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running days < 49 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running days < 35 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_finish_instrumented = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_instrumented_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_memory_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes

HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_finish_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_running days < 28 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_running days < 14 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_theory_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_cancel_theory = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_viira_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -45
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -30 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running days < 35 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running days < 21 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_finish_instrumented = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {

   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_instrumented_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_notation_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_control_b

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_response_b

  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_experiment_active
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_rig_b } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b }

 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_respond_a = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_can_respond_a = yes }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_0_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_1_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_2_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_3_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_0_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_1_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_2_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_3_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_response_a
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b }
   NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_control_b } }
   add_political_power = -23
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_0_mission
  }
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b }
   has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_control_b }
   add_political_power = -20
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_1_mission
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b
   NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_control_b } }
   add_political_power = -35
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_2_mission
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b
   has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_control_b }
   add_political_power = -31
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_3_mission
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}

   HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_timer_valid = yes

    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_running days < 70 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_running days < 42 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_theory_revised_contract

HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_viira_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -120
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -85 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running days < 112 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running days < 84 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented_timer_valid = yes

    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running days < 63 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_instrumented_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_chorus_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_revised_contract
  add_political_power = -20
  activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_mission
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_cancel_theory = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_revised_contract
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_finish_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running days < 28 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running days < 14 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_theory_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_cancel_theory = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_leopold_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -55
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -40 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}

 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_civilian

 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running days < 35 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running days < 21 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_finish_instrumented = {

  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_instrumented_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_prosthetics_trials_running days < 28 } } }

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_experiment_record

  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_running days < 35 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_running days < 21 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_leopold_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -65
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -50 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running days < 49 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running days < 35 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_self_repair_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_crystal_drive_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_revised_contract

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_civilian

   add_political_power = -55
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -40 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_field

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_paid_rig_b

HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_running days < 35 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_running days < 21 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_sorting_engine_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_running days < 35 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_running days < 21 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_theory_valid = no }

 }

  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_silver_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -50
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -35 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}

 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes

HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_running days < 49 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_running days < 35 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_necrotic_suture_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_experiment_record
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_experiment_active
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_rig_b } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_paid_rig_b }
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_control_b } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_paid_control_b }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_field

   add_political_power = -60
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -45 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}

 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_civilian

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_paid_rig_b

HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_running days < 56 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_running days < 42 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_tissue_bank_cancel_trials = yes
 }

 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_can_respond_b = yes }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_0_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_1_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_2_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_3_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_0_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_1_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_2_mission
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_3_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_response_b
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_rig_b }
   NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_control_b } }
   add_political_power = -21
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_0_mission
  }
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_rig_b }
   has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_control_b }
   add_political_power = -18
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_1_mission
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_rig_b
   NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_control_b } }
   add_political_power = -5
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_2_mission
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_rig_b
   has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_paid_control_b }
   add_political_power = -2
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_3_mission
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}

  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_revised_contract

 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_cancel_theory = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_revised_contract
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_finish_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_running days < 28 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_running days < 14 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_theory_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_cancel_theory = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_silver_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -45
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -30 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_done } }

HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_spell_sterilisation_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_finish_instrumented = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_instrumented_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_running days < 35 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_running days < 21 } } }
   }

  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_instrumented_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ritual_brake_done

 }

    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_silent_witness_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_silent_witness_trials_running days < 35 } } }

   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_silent_witness_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_start_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_can_theory = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_revised_contract
  add_political_power = -35
  activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_mission
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_cancel_theory = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_revised_contract
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_finish_theory = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_revised_contract
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_running HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_theory_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_cancel_theory = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_asinti_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -60
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -45 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running days < 63 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running days < 49 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_finish_instrumented = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running days < 56 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running days < 42 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_instrumented_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_empty_vessel_trials_valid = no }

 }

    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_theory_running days < 56 } } }
   }

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_theory_revised_contract

HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_start_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_can_trials = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_asinti_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -130
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -95 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_cancel_trials = {
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_revised_contract
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_instrumented_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_a_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_a_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_a_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_a_3_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_b_0_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_b_1_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_b_2_mission
 remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_b_3_mission
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_experiment_active
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_observation_ready
 clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_running
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_done } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_field
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_rig_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_control_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_experiment_active
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_observation_ready
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_verify_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_paid_rig_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_paid_control_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_response_a
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_response_b
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_experiment_record
 }
 HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running days < 119 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running days < 91 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_contact_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}

  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_mission
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_running
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_theory_revised_contract

  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }

  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_instrumented
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_civilian
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_field
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_viira_instrumented }
   add_political_power = -65
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_instrumented
   activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_instrumented_mission
  }
  else = { add_political_power = -50 activate_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_mission }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_finish_trials = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running days < 49 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running days < 35 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_done
  }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_refresh = yes
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_valid = no }
  HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_cancel_trials = yes
 }
}
HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_finish_instrumented = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_instrumented_timer_valid = yes
   OR = {
    AND = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running days < 42 } } }
    AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running days < 28 } } }
   }
  }
  remove_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_instrumented_mission
  if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_experiment_active } set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_observation_ready }
  else = {
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_running
   clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_trials_revised_contract
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_interrupt_notation_done

HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_pulse = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_programme_access = yes }
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized
 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_initialized }
  if = {
   limit = { HSM_BAR_mtk_institution = no }
   HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_teardown = yes
  }
  else = {
   if = {
    limit = {
     OR = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_running has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_mission }
     OR = { HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_valid = no NOT = { has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_theory_mission } }
    }
    HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_cancel_theory = yes
   }
   if = {
    limit = {
     OR = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_running has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_experiment_active
     has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_observation_ready
     has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_running
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_instrumented_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_0_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_1_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_2_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_a_3_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_0_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_1_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_2_mission
     has_active_mission = HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_verify_b_3_mission }
     OR = { HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_trials_valid = no NOT = { OR = {

HSM_BAR_mtk_projects_ai_week = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_ai = yes HSM_BAR_mtk_work_access = yes has_war = no OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_week_tick } NOT = { has_country_flag = { flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_week_tick days < 7 } } } }
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_week_tick
  set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_week_tick
  clr_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch
  HSM_BAR_mtk_viira_select_replication = yes
  HSM_BAR_mtk_leopold_select_replication = yes
  HSM_BAR_mtk_silver_select_replication = yes
  HSM_BAR_mtk_asinti_select_replication = yes
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch } HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_can_trials = yes NOT = { has_political_power < 135 } }
   HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_start_trials = yes
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch
  }
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch } HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_can_theory = yes NOT = { has_political_power < 125 } }
   HSM_BAR_mtk_field_atlas_start_theory = yes
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch
  }
  if = {
   limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch } HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_can_trials = yes NOT = { has_political_power < 140 } }
   HSM_BAR_mtk_shared_senses_start_trials = yes
   set_country_flag = HSM_BAR_mtk_ai_dispatch
  }
  if = {
